class WangBrush:
    """Dynamic virtual brush of Wang, Chen, Deng, Hutchinson, Dellaert (IROS 2020, arXiv 1911.08002, Sec. IV-B), re-implemented from
    the paper. State (x, y, z, w, d, o, θ) + the mark's root. One update per 100 Hz physics step from the tip (= the end effector X;
    the brush is held vertically, so π(X) is the tip's xy) and the press depth z (m, > 0 below the paper):
        w <- K_w w + (1 - K_w) Width(z)          d <- K_d d + (1 - K_d) Drag(z)                           (eqs. 6, 7)
        o <- min(Offset(z), |π(X) - root|)        the hairs stay put on the paper until the handle is Offset(z) away   (eq. 8)
        θ <- direction from the root to π(X)      root <- π(X) - o V(θ)                                     (eqs. 1, 9)
    Width/Drag/Offset(z) = the Fig. 4 fits (BRUSH_WANG), 0 when the tip is not below the paper (the hairs straighten: o = 0, the
    root snaps to the handle). Gaps filled here (documented in DESIGN): eq. 9 as printed (V^-1(root - π(X))) has the opposite sign of
    eq. 1; we follow eq. 1 and Fig. 3 (the flat end faces the handle, the drag tail points away from it). θ keeps its value while
    |π(X) - root| <= theta_eps: 0.1 mm in the air, where the root follows the handle, so θ becomes the direction of travel, which

    tail sweep a disc at every touch-down (measured, DESIGN §17). A dip restores the brush (w = d = o = 0, θ unset), as the paper's

const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/bodyopt.py
+import json, time, cv2, numpy as np
+from scipy.optimize import differential_evolution
+from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt
+from fit import TARGET,default,render,metrics
+from optfit import warp
+
+target=TARGET
+far=distance_transform_edt(~target)>4.5
+with open('/app/output/top.json') as f: top=json.load(f)
+paths=top+default()[2:]
+masks=[render([p]) for p in paths]
+
+def obj(mask):
+    fp=mask&~target;fn=target&~mask
+    return (1.1*np.count_nonzero(fp)+np.count_nonzero(fn)+1.3*np.count_nonzero(mask&far))/np.count_nonzero(target)
+
+def full_score():
+    union=np.logical_or.reduce(masks)
+    return obj(union),metrics(union)
+
+def save(tag):
+    with open('/app/output/body.json','w') as f:json.dump(paths,f)
+    ink=np.logical_or.reduce(masks)
+    cv2.imwrite('/app/output/body_overlay.png',np.where((target&ink)[:,:,None],(0,0,0),np.where((target&~ink)[:,:,None],(0,0,255),np.where((ink&~target)[:,:,None],(255,0,0),(245,245,245)))).astype('uint8'))
+    print(tag,full_score(),flush=True)
+
+def fit_affine_i(i, seed=0):
+    other=np.logical_or.reduce([m for j,m in enumerate(masks) if j!=i])
+    old=paths[i]
+    def fun(x):return obj(other|render([warp(old,x)]))
+    b=[(-100,100),(-90,100),(0.5,1.5),(0.5,1.5),(0.5,1.6)]
+    res=differential_evolution(fun,b,seed=seed,popsize=8,maxiter=45,tol=.002,polish=False)
+    trial=warp(old,res.x);newmask=render([trial])
+    if obj(other|newmask) < obj(other|masks[i]):paths[i]=trial;masks[i]=newmask
+    print('affine',i,res.x,full_score(),flush=True)
+
+def tune_i(i,nrounds=3,seed=0):
+    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); arr=np.array(paths[i],float)
+    other=np.logical_or.reduce([m for j,m in enumerate(masks) if j!=i])
+    best=obj(other|masks[i])
+    for scale in [12,6,3,1.5]:
+      for rnd in range(nrounds):
+       for j in rng.permutation(len(arr)):
+        for dim in rng.permutation(3):
+         step=scale*(0.055 if dim==2 else 1)
+         for sgn in (-1,1):
+          trial=arr.copy();trial[j,dim]+=sgn*step
+          if dim==2:trial[j,dim]=np.clip(trial[j,dim],0.4,18)
+          m=render([trial.tolist()]);score=obj(other|m)
+          if score<best:
+           best=score;arr=trial;masks[i]=m
+    paths[i]=arr.tolist()
+    print('tune',i,full_score(),flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+  save('initial')
+  for cyc in range(2):
+    for i in [3,4,5,2]:
+      fit_affine_i(i,cyc*10+i)
+      save(f'affine{cyc}_{i}')
+    for i in [3,4,5,2]:
+      tune_i(i,4,cyc*10+i)
+      save(f'tune{cyc}_{i}')
*** End Patch";

const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate the six-contact Yong trajectory from the fitted brush paths."""
+import json, sys, time
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_brush import Session
+
+ROOT=Path('/app/output')
+PX=227.18/1024
+def uv_world(u,v):
+    return -0.1+0.11359225406467-(v+0.5)*PX/1000, 0.11359225406467-(u+0.5)*PX/1000
+
+def samples(path,ds_px=1.5):
+    out=[]
+    for a,b in zip(path[:-1],path[1:]):
+        n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/ds_px)))
+        for j in range(n):
+            t=j/n;out.append([a[k]*(1-t)+b[k]*t for k in range(3)])
+    out.append(path[-1]);return np.asarray(out,float)
+
+def run(paths,output=ROOT/'trajectory.npz',lead_mm=0.6):
+    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
+    def move(q,sp=.06,settle=4):
+        ret=p['move_tip'](q,speed=sp,settle=settle)
+        if ret['ik_failures']:print('IK',ret,flush=True)
+    move((-0.1,0.15,0.055),.10,4)
+    move((-0.1,0.15,0.024),.025,5)
+    print('dip',s.brush_state(),flush=True)
+    move((-0.1,0.15,0.055),.04,4)
+    for idx,path in enumerate(paths):
+        pp=samples(path)
+        xy=np.array([uv_world(u,v) for u,v,_ in pp])
+        xyz=np.c_[xy,.020-pp[:,2]/1000]
+        tangent=xy[1]-xy[0];tangent=tangent/max(1e-9,np.linalg.norm(tangent))
+        pre=xy[0]-0.008*tangent
+        move((pre[0],pre[1],.045),.12,4)
+        move((xy[0,0],xy[0,1],.045),.03,5)
+        move(xyz[0],.012,6)
+        for j in range(1,len(xyz)):
+            direction=xyz[min(j+1,len(xyz)-1),:2]-xyz[max(0,j-1),:2]
+            norm=np.linalg.norm(direction)
+            if norm>1e-9:direction=direction/norm
+            else:direction=np.zeros(2)
+            lead=min(lead_mm/1000, np.linalg.norm(xyz[-1,:2]-xyz[j,:2])*0.5)
+            pos=xyz[j].copy();pos[:2]+=lead*direction
+            q,ok,err=s.ik(pos)
+            if not ok:print('IK step',idx,j,err,flush=True);q=s.hold_action()
+            s.step(q)
+        q,ok,err=s.ik(xyz[-1]);s.step(q if ok else s.hold_action());p['hold'](5)
+        move((xy[-1,0],xy[-1,1],.045),.025,4)
+        print('stroke',idx+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'samples',len(pp),'measured',[(t['sheet'],len(t['samples'])) for t in s.strokes()],flush=True)
+    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,output,meta={'fit':'body.json','lead_mm':lead_mm})
+    ink=s.ink();Image.fromarray((255-ink*245).astype('uint8')).save(ROOT/'actual.png')
+    np.save(ROOT/'actual.npy',ink)
+    with open(ROOT/'realized.json','w') as f:
+        json.dump([{'samples':t['samples'].tolist(),'sheet':t['sheet']} for t in s.strokes()],f)
+    print('score',s.status(),flush=True)
+    return s
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    fitfile=ROOT/(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'body.json')
+    paths=json.loads(fitfile.read_text())
+    lead=float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 0.6
+    run(paths,lead_mm=lead)
*** End Patch";
